title: Reactree
description: A React 18/19 component (three props: newick, fasta, defaultHeight) that draws a Newick tree as one D3 SVG with a built-in editing toolbar and an optional FASTA alignment panel.

applied: library chrome (toolbar, sliders, buttons, popovers, node-info panel, clade editor): its --clr-primary/surface/text/border/--font-family custom properties mapped onto GBIF tokens (--color-primary, --bg1, --bg-surface, --bg2, --slate-*, --fg1, --fg2, --text-subtle, --font-body) by CSS on :root (global, because the colour palette, export menu and clade editor are portaled to <body>)

dark mode: the library's own data-theme="dark" on <html> switched from props.theme.dark; dark values come from GBIF tokens (--bg-dark, --grey-200..500, --slate-200, --bg1); the shell itself stays light (the shell has no dark mode)

branches, node dots and tip labels: hard-coded hex presentation attributes in the library's JS, re-themed with CSS attribute selectors on those exact hex values (path[stroke="#475569"], circle[fill="#47556940"], text.leaf-label[style*="rgb(71, 85, 105)"]) to --fg2 / --fg1 (dark: --slate-200 / white)
tip label font: CSS rule svg text {font-family: var(--font-body)} overrides the font-family presentation attribute (Rubik); the library keeps labels italic
highlight rings: our own SVG circles in --color-primary; tip links underlined, focus ring in --color-accent-blue
outer card radius and shadow aligned with the shell card (--radius-md, none) through the library's stable class name .Reactree_outer

runner tokens (background, foreground, branch, highlight, fontFamily) set as CSS custom properties on our wrapper and verified in the computed styles of branches, dots, labels and the container (light and dark)
not_possible: clade colours: only the library's 12 fixed palette colours (Tailwind-like red, orange, amber, lime, emerald, teal, sky, indigo, violet, pink, slate, brown) exist; the GBIF categorical palette cannot be used, the adapter picks the nearest swatch
alignment panel: canvas drawn with hard-coded residue colours, system-ui font, 14 px cells and 172 px label canvas; no token reaches it; zebra and chip colours are HSL from the row index
search glow, reroot/flip/swap rings, bootstrap (red) and branch-length (cyan) labels, collapse triangles and tooltips: colours hard-coded in JS (indigo, amber, emerald, cyan); not re-themed
node shapes and sizes, branch width (library slider 0.5 to 4 only), the dot-grid background and the fixed 26 px row pitch
the toolbar cannot be hidden or reordered (no option); it is nowrap with overflow hidden, so on a card narrower than about 1000 px (and on a phone) its right-hand controls are cut off
hover state: only the library's own ring and tooltips inside its edit modes; nothing styleable by token
tooltip chrome for our hover events: the shell draws it, the library has none outside its edit modes
styling.notes: Tokens reach the chrome and (with attribute-selector overrides) the tree, but not the canvas alignment panel or any state colour. The attribute-selector overrides depend on the exact hex strings in reactreejs 1.0.3 and would break silently on a release that changes them. Dark mode is global: data-theme on <html> also affects any other component on the page that reads it.
